استصحبن (form X)
# اِسْتَصْحَبْنَ (istaṣḥabna) /is.tasˤ.ħab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَصْحَبَ (istaṣḥaba)
# اُسْتُصْحِبْنَ (ustuṣḥibna) /us.tusˤ.ħib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَصْحَبَ (istaṣḥaba)
# اِسْتَصْحِبْنَ (istaṣḥibna) /is.tasˤ.ħib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَصْحَبَ (istaṣḥaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
